info.name: Hetzner Cloud Actions Image Actions API

params.name: id
params.description:
Filter the actions by ID. May be used multiple times.

The response will only contain actions matching the specified IDs.

params.name: sort
params.description:
Sort actions by field and direction. May be used multiple times.

For more information, see "[Sorting](#description/sorting)".

params.name: status
params.description:
Filter the actions by status. May be used multiple times.

The response will only contain actions matching the specified statuses.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to return. For more information, see "[Pagination](#description/pagination)".

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of entries returned per page. For more information, see "[Pagination](#description/pagination)".

items.docs: Returns all Action objects. You can `sort` the results by using the sort URI parameter, and filter them with the `status` and `id` parameter.
